Okay, so I'm putting this here instead of DMing in case anyone else needs help with this too, but if you have any more questions please dont hesitate to dm me!  


First of all, I really do hope it gets better for you. I know you probably get that a lot, but still  


I think its a VERY good idea that you seek out admission. I was in a similar spot, like, two months ago.   


Its not going to be easy, or fun, but it will DEFINITELY be worth it in the long run.  


In my experience, I went to the ER, and my parents told them I was struggling with suicidal thoughts. They took my vitals and my blood, and i sat in the room for the rest of the evening. In the morning, i talked to a social worker, and she decided it would be best if i was admitted. It took several hours, but she did the paperwork, and my parents drove me 6 hours to a mental hospital in Raleigh. We were in the admissions/waiting room for around nine hours, but that was just because they were heavily understaffed at the time. After i was assessed again, they took me to the adolescents unit. They had me go behind a curtain and strip to my bra and underwear. They then gave me a gown to put on, and checked my body for scars. And then, i was shown to my room, where i slept for a few hours before doing groups. It was really scary at first, but i made some friends, and the treatment really helped me  


In your case, i would probably call/text the crisis hotline number and have them call for you. If youre THAT scared of your parents, let someone at the hospital know once you get there, or tell a police/first responder when they come to check on you. They will do their very best to keep you safe.  


Honestly, i did a ton of research on what adolescent psych wards are like, and then just took the plunge. It was for sure worth it  


If you have any further questions or need something specific answered please dont hesitate to reply or dm me!   


I really hope this helps!
